rationale: This instrument shows extreme characteristics that make reliable directional trading nearly impossible: a 597 bps bid-ask spread, a gap of 73.6% from prior close, an intraday range from $2.97 to $10.74 (over 260% range), and the current price sitting well below both the 5-min VWAP ($5.15) and 9-EMA ($5.01) after a massive spike and collapse. The spread alone would require a multi-percent move just to break even, and with no news context, no candle data, and no historical comparable setups, there is no identifiable edge in either direction. The risk of adverse fills and whipsaw in this illiquid, highly volatile name far exceeds any potential reward.
